recommendation: Keep the source fix. It completes the applied Jira request in an active resource and leaves generated SVG output for the normal build pipeline rather than editing generated-looking artifacts manually.
issue_request: FHIR-53200 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 by FM. It asked to match PaymentReconciliation.processNote to ClaimResponse and add a 0..* allocation-level note reference so allocations can point to process notes.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged implementation commit 4291efa10d83fd2679fc5c5b3f6113795298ee98, merged by HL7/fhir#3796, added PaymentReconciliation.allocation.noteNumber plus processNote.class and processNote.number. That left PaymentReconciliation.processNote only partially aligned with ClaimResponse because type stayed a required code, text stayed 0..1, language was absent, and the explicit backbone type name remained plural.
additional_context: PaymentReconciliation and ClaimResponse are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini. ClaimResponse is the requested comparison target and currently defines processNote as Note with class, number, CodeableConcept/extensible type, required markdown text, and optional language. Related applied or published FM decisions explain the current ClaimResponse shape. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community guidance.
reconciliation: Changed PaymentReconciliation.processNote to use explicit type name Note, changed processNote.type to CodeableConcept with extensible note-type binding, made processNote.text 1..1, added processNote.language with the same language binding pattern, and updated the PaymentReconciliation example to encode processNote.type as a CodeableConcept.
source_changes: source/paymentreconciliation/structuredefinition-PaymentReconciliation.xml: completed PaymentReconciliation.processNote alignment with ClaimResponse by updating the backbone type name, type datatype/binding, text cardinality, and language element.
source/paymentreconciliation/paymentreconciliation-example.xml: changed the example processNote.type from primitive code syntax to CodeableConcept syntax.

related_jiras.note: Changed ClaimResponse and ExplanationOfBenefit processNote.type to CodeableConcept/extensible, establishing part of the ClaimResponse shape mirrored here.
Added processNote.class to ClaimResponse and ExplanationOfBenefit, which the initial FHIR-53200 commit partially copied to PaymentReconciliation.
Changed PaymentReconciliation.processNote.text to markdown and was part of the same processNote family.
Changed ClaimResponse.processNote.text to markdown, part of the requested comparison target history.
Unresolved terminology follow-up for processNote.class, so it was not decided here.
